attack_model.formula: final_aps = base_aps * (1 + sum(increased_attack_speed)) * product(1 + more_attack_speed groups); base_aps = 0.75 / useDuration_s * speedMultiplier * 1.46667 = 1.3750031 (reference planner runtime; weapon attackRate is display-only)

alternatives.note: third-party planner runtime fast path: base rate only depends on useDuration; weapon attackRate is display-only

alternatives.formula: average equipped weapon attackRate (Rune Hammer 0.94 / Katana 1.20)
alternatives.note: chosen default; the reference runtime does not model dual-wield weapon rate aggregation

dual_wield.attack_rate: skill base rate from useDuration/as (user rule 2026-11-07); weapon attackRate not read
dual_wield.added_weapon_damage: sum: all equipped weapon added damage enters the pool (user rule 2026-11-07)

attack_speed_pool.tag_filter: rows tagged Melee / untagged apply; Spell-only and DoT-only rows never apply

attack_model.note: R2 unresolved: the third-party planner runtime has no dual-wield model (weapon added damage summed, rate from skill as). Default follows that reference (candidate A). Candidate B (average weapon attackRate 1.07 / per-hit average added damage) is the physically plausible alternative and is kept in alternatives; the two differ by ~28% in APS and 2x in added damage.
attack_model.user_confirmation: base_aps = as × speedMultiplier 与“双持两把武器 added 直接相加”已由用户确认（2026-11-07）。

damage_model.formula: component = (base + added * added_damage_scaling) * (1 + sum(increased[tags])) * product(1 + sum(more per group)[tags]) * avg_crit * (1 + penetration) * (1 - target_resistance) * (1 - monster_dr)
damage_model.extra_damage_type_policy_note: Flame Reave 无伤害转换（Rolling Thunder/Rolling Flames 未选转换），非 Fire 类型的显式 added damage（例如 sealed +5 Physical）不进入 Fire 组件；列入 excluded/assumed。
damage_model.added_untyped_policy: type-less added damage (e.g. '+64 Melee Damage') is treated as the skill's damage type (Fire); assumed
damage_model.tag_filter: no tags = generic; all tags must be contained in the component closure {Fire, Melee, Hit}; Elemental expands onto element components; Spell/DoT-only never apply
damage_model.dot_policy: DoT-only modifiers (tags include DoT without Hit) are excluded from hit damage

critical.formula: crit_chance = (base_chance + added_chance) * (1 + sum(increased_chance)) * product(1 + more_chance groups), capped at chance_cap; crit_multiplier = (base_multiplier + added_multiplier) * (1 + sum(increased_multiplier)) * product(1 + more_multiplier groups); avg_crit = (1 - crit_chance) + crit_chance * crit_multiplier

rules.assumption: 快照把两个节点归一为 added 0.01 / increased 0.08；按属性缩放的公式未验证，暂按快照值计入。

open_questions.question: OQ6 暴击被动的 per-attribute 缩放公式（Prodigy per 15 Int / Defender per Dex）是否应按属性值展开，而不是用快照归一值？
FR 点燃的 DoT 伤害是否要作为独立组件接入（当前只建模 ignited 条件）？

items: 双持：两把武器都生效，added damage 直接相加（不取平均）。
攻速基础公式：base_aps = as × speedMultiplier（= 1.1 × speedMultiplier / useDuration），武器 attackRate 不参与。
无类型 added damage 是自适应伤害，本案例按 Fire 结算。
技能等级：离线存档 bug，实际 27 级；等级只影响技能节点数量、不影响伤害；FR 已按 27 点建树。
每次施放对同一目标 4 击（1 次基础 + 3 次返回）；多击次数应作为可配置条件参数。
距离衰减作为条件 Buff：当前按贴脸（不触发），远程最多 50% less。（实现状态：v2 起未建模——ruleset 无距离/半径 effect，只有 states.target_in_melee_range 默认 true；远程衰减曲线待研究。）
Firebrand 层数只对 Firebrand 自己生效，不作用于 Flame Reave。
OQ6 的暴击类被动（Prodigy / Defender of Welryn）计入暴击率。
Whetstone Gavel 的 offhand 应为 Exalted（显示稀有度由 T6+ 词缀决定），待核对副手数值后再决定建模方式。（实现状态：已按 Exalted 处理——effects.offhand_exalted_effect 对副手全部 stats ×(1+97%) 计入；换副手/稀有度需重算。）
Exalted = 有 T6/T7 词缀的 Rare 装备；本地 BD 已把副手显示稀有度修正为 Exalted（离线存档 raw byte 4 是 bug，不改存档）。
Enchant Weapon 只要有近战命中就激活（常驻）。
Frenzy / Firebrand / Blade Weaving / Ambition / Haste 的数值以本地 dataset 为准：Frenzy +20% attack/cast speed、+128% increased Effect → +45.6%；Haste 只加移动速度。
点燃只建模 FR 自身相关的来源（FR 树 Ignite Chance / Arcane Flames）；其他技能的点燃来源不建模。
high health 作为可勾选的目标条件；Rhythm of Fire 作为可勾选的 buff（当次施放是否有 12 层可消耗）；mana 相关当前都不建模。
Whetstone Gavel offhand：副手全部 stats 均获得 +97% effectiveness（用户确认）。
tier 显示倍率词缀（crit multi/shred/chill）按展示值归一：84% / 291% / 28%；这是装备位置缩放差异。
距离衰减先不管，只研究贴脸（不建立远程条件）。（实现状态：v2 起未建模，只有 states.target_in_melee_range 默认 true；远程衰减曲线待研究。）
R8：没有转伤机制，非 Fire 的 added/typed damage 不会被转成 Fire。
